formal_object.rationale: The additive independent-noise model describes raw paired coordinates, whereas legacy input is nonlinearly normalized.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: B05: E(q-c)^2/2=n and E(qc)=v. Condition: All stated independence and equal-variance conditions hold H02: The optimal denoising coefficient cannot be transferred as an optimal retrieval score without a ranking model. Condition: The two objectives differ

derivation.rationale: Moment and scalar LMMSE identities are valid before normalization. r q denoising does not derive a pair-ranking metric.

assumptions.rationale: Noises are independent of signal and each other, and moment identities precede nonlinear unit normalization. v,n are nonnegative population variances; clipped sample estimates are not proven optimal. The LMMSE predictor zhat=r q does not itself derive a diagonal pair-ranking metric. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: A retrieval decision rule/risk is not derived; two-sided denoising yields r^2 qc while legacy scoring uses r qc. The construction check stays pending.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Actual paired raw-feature moments and post-normalization distortions must support the noise interpretation; useful complementary semantics in q-c would falsify it. Falsification: Independent-noise assumptions fail, or a legal denoiser/diagonal metric explains equal outcomes without the proposed ranking interpretation.

closest_alternative.rationale: Wiener/LMMSE and diagonal metrics are relevant alternatives, but semantic noise assumptions and a fair ranking comparison remain unresolved. This check only reviews the stated mathematical comparison; exhaustive full-text/author-code/native collision and originality decisions remain pending.
